d: Shoulder-length, wavy charcoal-black hair is styled with straight-cut bangs and a single silver hairclip on the left side. The amber-gold eyes are wide with a neutral, serious expression on a youthful face. The build is slender, dressed in a short-sleeved white blouse under a black sleeveless vest, paired with a blue ribbon tie and a pleated black mini-skirt with white stripes at the hem. Accessories include white gloves and a brown strap supporting a grey metallic mechanical gear assembly featuring gun barrels and a boxy chassis.
